raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Hybrid READ completion cleanup can discard transfer tracking, or notify P to release blocks, while another transfer remains pending. Raise `TransferError` on failure or timeout before cleanup changes ownership.

Rebased onto main `bfa7e5b7afe40ebe48288801a2baf5c1135cd881`. This remains an independent child of closed #58968.

## Claims

```diff
D observes hybrid READ [FAILED, PENDING] or an expired pending READ
- enter completion cleanup and lose in-flight tracking
+ raise before release notification or tracking deletion
```

Successful hybrid completion and existing attention-only recovery retain their behavior.

## Validation

Validated on `7fac33a0118fba54e5f83f612e40088ece8ca8d3` (2026-10-12): **34 passed**. Changed-file pre-commit passed, including mypy for Python 3.11 and test/CI tethering checks.

```bash
VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -ra \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_moriio_tp_ack.py
```

The suite covers both failed/pending orders, timeout, completed transfers, a pending request at the deadline and attention-only failure. It asserts release notifications, transfer tracking and invalid-block reporting. Original October 8 negative controls (`194da61de1`) gave **3 failed / 3 passing controls**, versus six passing cases with the fix.

No new model/RDMA run was performed. Exact-source fault-injection/teardown validation remains pending. Raising prevents this cleanup path from releasing ownership; it does not prove DMA drain or revocation.

The eight independent PRs compose on this same main. The combined CPU suite passes **344 tests**, with **33 skips** (32 ROCm/aiter-gated connector cases and one GPU LLM case) and **one model-loading deselection**. Counts overlap with the independent suites.

## Details

The normal layer/step wait already raises on failed transfers. The missing guard is in `_pop_done_transfers`, reached from READ completion collection. Hybrid state has no safe fallback through the attention-only invalid-block recovery path.

Raising prevents this cleanup path from releasing ownership; it does not drain/revoke DMA or provide automatic recovery. Producer retention until a real ACK is separate work in #56465. That PR also modifies consumer timeout notification, so composition must preserve this hybrid exception before any timeout release. #58962 concerns WRITE consumer timeout; #60544 adds hybrid WRITE and batch waits. Neither is this READ cleanup guard. #58968 was closed after the split.

**Merge danger:** two-way door; blast radius: MoRIIO hybrid READ error handling. A failed hybrid transfer aborts instead of continuing with incomplete recurrent state.

#60808 moves input waits into `start_load_kv`; it does not provide DMA drain/revoke or replace this completion-cleanup guard. Producer ACK retention remains separate in #56465.

AI assistance was used for implementation, rebase, regression checks and this description. Human line-by-line review and the runtime acceptance items above remain pending. No performance improvement is claimed.

@@ -460,6 +460,80 @@ def test_failed_read_reports_blocks_only_without_hma(has_mamba, expected_invalid
     assert worker.get_block_ids_with_load_errors() == expected_invalid
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "states,elapsed,has_mamba,error",
+    [
+        (["failed", "pending"], 1, True, "failed"),
+        (["pending", "failed"], 1, True, "failed"),
+        (["pending"], 121, True, "timed out"),
+        (["done", "done"], 121, True, None),
+        (["pending"], 120, True, None),
+        (["failed", "pending"], 1, False, None),
+    ],
+)
+def test_read_completion_preserves_hybrid_blocks_on_error(
+    monkeypatch, states, elapsed, has_mamba, error
+):
+    class Status:
+        def __init__(self, state):
+            self.state = state
+
+        def Succeeded(self):
+            return self.state == "done"
+
+        def Failed(self):
+            return self.state == "failed"
+
+        def Message(self):
+            return self.state
+
+        def Code(self):
+            return self.state
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        "vllm.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_connector.v1.moriio.moriio_connector.time.monotonic",
+        lambda: 1000.0,
+    )
+    worker = MoRIIOConnectorWorker.__new__(MoRIIOConnectorWorker)
+    worker.is_producer = False
+    worker.mode = MoRIIOMode.READ
+    worker.world_size = 8
+    worker._has_mamba = has_mamba
+    worker.moriio_config = SimpleNamespace(recv_abort_timeout=120.0)
+    worker.moriio_wrapper = MoRIIOWrapper()
+    notifications = []
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        worker.moriio_wrapper,
+        "send_notify",
+        lambda *args, **kwargs: notifications.append((args, kwargs)),
+    )
+    worker._recving_transfers = {"req": {"layer": [Status(state) for state in states]}}
+    worker._recving_transfers_callback_addr = {"req": ("host", "7000", "tx")}
+    worker._recving_transfers_start = {"req": 1000.0 - elapsed}
+    worker._recving_local_blocks = {"req": [7, 8]}
+    worker._invalid_block_ids = set()
+
+    if error is not None:
+        with pytest.raises(TransferError, match=error):
+            worker.get_finished()
+        assert notifications == []
+        assert "req" in worker._recving_transfers
+        assert worker._recving_transfers_callback_addr == {
+            "req": ("host", "7000", "tx")
+        }
+        assert worker._recving_transfers_start == {"req": 1000.0 - elapsed}
+        assert worker._recving_local_blocks == {"req": [7, 8]}
+        assert worker.get_block_ids_with_load_errors() == set()
+    else:
+        assert worker.get_finished() == (set(), set())
+        completed = states == ["done", "done"] or not has_mamba
+        assert len(notifications) == int(completed)
+        assert bool(worker._recving_transfers) is not completed
+        assert worker.get_block_ids_with_load_errors() == (
+            set() if has_mamba else {7, 8}
+        )
+
